items.heading: Practising As an Advocate
items.text: Practising as an advocate in India needs enrolment with a State Bar Council, and the Bar Council of India conducts the All India Bar Examination for those who have graduated in law. Read the current notice of the Bar Council of India for the eligibility and exam pattern before you plan.

Learning under a senior is the real training, and income builds over years.
Graduate who prepares for judicial services
Few seats and long preparation, so plan a fallback.
Graduate who waits for a job to appear
Law jobs are found through internships, networks and proof of work.
